## Business Overview
M&D Parfum is a luxury perfume boutique that offers exclusive and high-quality fragrances. The ideal customer values individuality, self-expression through scent choices reflecting their lifestyle or occasion preferences such as weddings for FRENCH TOBACCO collections.
The business occupies an upscale niche market segment with unique offerings catering to connoisseurs of fine perfumes.
